completion_decisions: Implement the complete PIDNN training lifecycle, trained wake evaluator, 80-turbine problem and GTDE target method.
Use a deterministic actuator-disk Gaussian field over the exact paper domain when the unavailable ANSYS fields are required.
Retain paper network widths, optimizer, batch, learning rate, regularization and 10000-step training contract.
Digitize the paper wind rose and power curve and calibrate only to the reported regular-layout 1554.20 GWh anchor.
Treat each turbine coordinate pair as one vector-valued gene, resolving the paper's 80-versus-160 dimension wording without deleting a coordinate.
Use direct C++ LibTorch CPU/CUDA training plus batched PIDNN-table population evaluation.
Execute one paper-native run and a separately labelled 25-seed reconstruction robustness extension.
missing_information: ANSYS mesh, exact CFD boundary values, pressure, flow fields and all sample coordinates
target source, trained weights, optimizer state and random streams
numeric wind-rose, power-curve and Ct observation arrays
Ct encoder widths, pressure treatment, penalty coefficient, crossover rate and bounds handling
repeat count, complete layouts and convergence histories

paper.authors: Peiyi Li and Yanbo Che and Anran Hua and Lei Wang and Mengxiang Zheng and Xiaojiang Guo
paper.title: A Data-Physics Hybrid-Driven Layout Optimization Framework for Large-Scale Wind Farms

paper_source_conflicts: Eq.12 defines 80 x/y coordinate pairs while Section 6.3 calls the optimization dimension 80; preserve 80 vector-valued genes and 160 scalars.
Algorithm 1 can be read as immediately updating the best while the prose describes an offspring population; freeze the generation best for legal population-parallel HPC and declare the resolution.
The target paper provides no code/data URL and states data are available on request; the cited GTDE author page also requires an email request for code.

scope.claim_boundary: flexible equation-level academic reproduction of PIDNN plus GTDE and the paper problem; not author CFD, source, trained artifact, random trajectory, layout or numerical replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: 7 km square, pairwise distance at least 3D, reflection at bounds and paper penalty completed as 0.001 GWh per squared metre of summed violation

decision_variables.resolution: 80 vector-valued turbine genes containing x/y coordinates, represented as 160 scalars

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct continuous coordinate-pair genes with no hidden decoder

initialization.resolution: exact 8 by 10 regular layout plus bounded deterministic jitter for the remaining population

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: AEP, optimization ratio, feasibility, physical FES, stage timing and hashes; one native plus 25 robustness seeds

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize annual energy production minus the declared distance-violation penalty

paper_native_cases.resolution: one 7 km by 7 km, 80-turbine, 400 MW large-scale case with PIDNN and GTDE

parameters.resolution: paper PIDNN and GTDE parameters plus CR 0.9, reflection and visible penalty completion

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: population 300, initial 300 evaluations and 1000 generations of 300 trials for 300300 physical FES

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: train from scratch for 10000 Adam steps at batch 1024, save hashed artifact, distill and audit fixed wake table, then optimize

update_order.resolution: Adam steps and GTDE generations ordered; frozen-generation mutation and trial evaluation parallel; selection committed after complete population

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: dual PIDNN trained by data and physical residuals, quadratic wake superposition and NREL-5MW power reconstruction

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: 12 direction by six speed-band digitization normalized to 72 annual states
